title: The dating of raised-field agriculture in the Lake Titicaca basin, Peru
version: In Pre-Hispanic Agricultural Fields in the Andean Region, Part i, BAR International Series 359(i)

passages.quote: raised-field agriculture probably began around 1000 B.C., and was well established by 500 B.C.

passages.locator: End of the section before 'Discussion', p. 379
passages.quote: their abandonment occurred sometime after A.D. 300. The reconstruction and reutilization of these raised fields in Phase II probably began about A.D. 1000 and lasted until the Inca conquest of the lake zone sometime after A.D. 1450.
